wait_for_all_processes_to_stop: run the wait command to block until all running processes reach the STOPPED state
wait_for_specific_processes_to_stop: run the wait command with process names to block until those specific processes stop
wait_for_processes_with_timeout: run the wait command with a timeout value to stop waiting after a set number of seconds
get_system_state_procs: use life_cycle.system_state to get the current system state and list of running processes
register_system_state_watcher_callback: use life_cycle.system_state_watcher to register a callback that fires on system state changes
